reserve_profile.summary: Agora describes AUSD as fully reserved, with reserves including short-term U.S. Treasuries, overnight repurchase agreements, cash, and other liquid assets. Agora identifies VanEck as reserve manager, State Street as custodian, and Grant Thornton LLP as auditor. Historical token-specific allocation percentages are not inferred where not normalized from reviewed reports.
